items.what: Whether the India–US trade deal (first tranche) is signed. Manila now looks unlikely: a Quad summit there is unconfirmed and a formal Modi–Trump bilateral is unlikely. Observers point to the G20 summit in Florida on 14–15 Dec. Update (Nov 17): No signing is expected in Manila: there is no Modi–Trump bilateral, only the Quad group meeting. ThePrint sources point to a possible bilateral at the G20 in Florida (Dec 14–15), and the Indian official target is now March 2027 (see W-261116-06). Update (Nov 18): Trade was not discussed in any reported Modi–Trump exchange in Manila. There was no bilateral, and the Indian readouts make no mention of the deal. Update (Nov 19): Commerce Secretary Agrawal said (Nov 18) the deal is almost fully settled but cannot be signed until the US tariff architecture is in place and Section 301 outcomes are clear ([Tribune/ANI](https://tribuneindia.com/news/commerce-secretary/india-us-trade-deal-signing-awaits-new-us-tariff-framework-says-commerce-secretary)). Update (Nov 20): CEA Nageswaran (Nov 19, ANI) floated signing 'in early December or thereabouts'. That contrasts with Agrawal's line that signing awaits the US tariff framework. US Deputy Chief of Mission Meeks (Nov 19) repeated 'fair, reciprocal' language and gave no timeline. Update (Nov 25): Nov 24: No new statement on signing found in English or Hindi searches; Agrawal's 'awaits US tariff framework' line stands. Update (Nov 26): The Section 301 outcome Agrawal was waiting for has arrived in proposed form. On Nov 25 USTR proposed up to 25% on Indian goods, or 17% with a reciprocal trade agreement. India's Commerce Ministry rejected the excess-capacity finding and said concerns belong in the trade talks, which it wants concluded soon (The Week). No signing date was given. Update (Nov 27): Goyal (Nov 27, PTI) says the deal is 'close to culmination' and the process that held it back is taking shape; no date. Business Upturn adds he hopes to sign before end-2026, but that line is unsourced. Exporters (FIEO) urge a quick deal to secure 17%.

Update (Nov 19): Alaska resolved: AP called it for Peltola on Nov 17 without RCV, and certification is set for Nov 25. Mississippi certification status not found. Alaska still plans to certify on Nov 25 (Director Beecher to Democracy Docket, Nov 19), and Sullivan will not concede before certification. DOJ's Ninth Circuit appeal of Judge Gleason's dismissal of its certification suit is still pending. No Mississippi certification news found.

items.what: Prosecutors’ findings on motive and on whether anyone helped plan or supply the Kraków attack, and whether the case is discontinued after the attacker’s death Update (Nov 17): Minister Siemoniak (Rzeczpospolita, 16 Nov) says the attacker was fascinated by mass killers, the attack was planned, and so far there is no sign of an ideological motive or outside influence. Prosecutors have the attacker's route and are still looking for CCTV. If no relatives claim the body, Gibała will ask UJ Collegium Medicum to take it. Update (Nov 18): the attacker's closest relative has asked for the body. Prosecutors will release it after further examinations (PAP via KRKnews). No news on motive or CCTV. Update (Nov 19): Eryk Stasielak (National Prosecutor's Office, Małopolska) told Onet that police body cameras recorded the shooting, that more than 100 casings and four phones (one locked) were found in the car, and that a safe at the attacker's home held ammunition. Still no motive (TVN24). Update (Nov 20): no new prosecutor findings on motive or accomplices. Separately, police confirmed the two officers wore privately bought vests and will examine why (TVN24/KR24). Update (Nov 21): prosecutor Stasielak (PAP, 20 Nov) says the attacker fired more than 100 shots and CCTV traced his route. He held a permit for 10 firearms with two registered (AR-15, Glock), and prosecutors will question doctors and psychologists about how the permit was issued. They are seeking witnesses from ul. Grodzka. The body has been released, and RMF FM says a relative collected it. Toxicology is pending and no motive has been stated (nczas.info/PAP; Kraków Portal). Update (Nov 23): Rzeczpospolita/Interia report that prosecutors are preparing a court motion to lift medical secrecy so they can question the doctors who cleared the attacker for a gun permit; the psychologist needs a prosecutor's decision. Police Internal Affairs will review the permit. Still no stated motive (Interia). Update (Nov 24): No new findings on motive or accomplices; officer Kulik left hospital for rehabilitation. Update (Nov 25): No motive or accomplice findings yet. New: prosecutors are seeking the parents of a girl shot at on ul. Grodzka, which they class as attempted murder, and have several dozen CCTV recordings; Stasielak confirmed a circulating video is authentic (Rzeczpospolita, 24 Nov: https://www.rp.pl/przestepczosc/art45536421-zamachowiec-w-krakowie-strzelal-do-dziecka-prokuratura-szuka-rodzicow-dziewczynki). Update (Nov 26): No new prosecutor findings on motive or accomplices were found in sources checked for 25–26 Nov. The latest is the search for the parents of the girl shot at on ul. Grodzka (Rzeczpospolita, 24 Nov). Update (Nov 27): Prosecutor Stasielak (PAP, 26 Nov) says about 250 witnesses have been questioned and a 'foreign thread' is being examined, plus whether others inspired the attacker. Motive still unknown; toxicology due in 2-3 weeks (KRKnews: https://krknews.pl/nowe-informacje-po-zamachu-w-krakowie-sledczy-przesluchuja-swiadkow/).
